· Position vs SMA100/200 ($370.16/$366.64): Below long-term trends, maintaining strong bearish sentiment.

· RSI trajectory (34.3→40.8): Attempting to exit oversold territory, weak upward momentum confirmed.

[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing Resistance ($339.99): Short-term rebound expected if breached upwards.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (5-day low $319.30 vs 20-day low $319.30): Potential for sideways consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.82x): Surge, increasing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Entered oversold territory within a downtrend, short-term rebound possible but trend reversal uncertain, watch-and-see phase.
